services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: At Alpine Helicopters, we are dedicated to reducing our environmental impact, fostering a culture of environmental responsibility and playing our role in a sustainable future. Through our Green Initiative we aim to offset the greenhouse gas emissions generated from our Helicopter Tours in Canmore, AB, and Stoney Nakoda, AB, by investing in Gold Standard-certified carbon offsets with PlanetAir. While this represents a positive step forward, we aspire to make an even greater environmental impact, so we are also collaborating with One Tree Planted to plant trees as part of our commitment to a greener future. services.name: Charter Tariff
services.desc: Alpine’s aircraft are well equipped to provide a safe, comfortable and enjoyable flight experience. Our Bell series helicopters have VIP Interiors and are configured with a private passenger cabin area. We can accommodate 6 to 14 passengers. Dazzle your delegates by including one of our breathtaking heli tours in your programming. A scenic helicopter tour is a once in a lifetime experience and an exceptional way of showing your appreciation to your business partners, customers or employees. Looking for something a little different from one of our programmed Sightseeing Tours? Alpine offers custom helicopter tours from our full-service Tourism facilities in Canmore and Kananaskis, AB.

blurb: Alpine Helicopters operates sightseeing tours in Canmore and Stoney Nakoda, Alberta, showcasing the Canadian Rocky Mountains and local indigenous culture. They also provide helicopter-assisted experiences like heli-skiing, weddings, and back-country exploration. The company has multiple locations and offers private charters with VIP interiors.
